items.title: Peter Jackson’s Weta FX to Talk AI as Netflix’s Creative Asia Spotlights ‘Possible Love’ in Busan
items.excerpt: Netflix and the Busan International Film Festival bring back Creative Asia on Oct. 10, with Weta FX CTO Kimball Thurston on a panel about how AI and machine learning are reshaping VFX craft and the Asian production pipeline.

items.title: ‘Avengers’ Studio AGBO’s Chris Brearton, Dominic Hughes to Keynote Tokyo Market on Artist-Led AI in Storytelling
items.excerpt: TIFFCOM will host AGBO partner Chris Brearton and chief scientific officer Dominic Hughes on 'Technology Meets Storytelling,' framing an artist-led approach to AI inside the Russo brothers' studio.

items.title: Interview With Tilly Norwood Reveals Even Fewer Reasons For the Existence of the AI ‘Actress’
items.excerpt: Variety logs on to tillynorwood.com for an extended chat with the synthetic 'actress' from Particle6, and comes away with a sharper read on what a generative performer can and cannot do on screen.

items.title: Tilly Norwood Malfunctions During Piers Morgan Interview: “Seems I Had A Little Hiccup”
items.excerpt: The AI 'actress' from Particle6 switched from English to Cantonese midway through a live Piers Morgan interview, a public failure mode for synthetic-performer tech being pitched to studios.

items.title: ‘Adolescence’ Scribe Jack Thorne Claims Fellow Writers Are Using AI To “Cheat” & Says Those Caught Should Be Punished
items.excerpt: In a WGGB speech, Jack Thorne alleged that some screenwriters are quietly generating scripts with AI and called for enforcement — a live question for how script craft and credit get policed.

items.title: ‘The View’s Sunny Hostin Defends AI As “New Art Form” Amid “Gatekeeping In Hollywood Around Black & Brown Creative Content”
items.excerpt: Sunny Hostin, who licensed her name and likeness to AI company Fountain 0, argued on The View that generative AI is a 'new art form' that can route around Hollywood gatekeeping — drawing pushback from her co-hosts.

items.title: Gen AI Founder: Tools Won’t Replace Live Film Production – Yet
items.excerpt: OpenArt CEO Coco Mao told the Access Canada Summit that generative tools are still complements to live-action shooting, mapping where AI actually lands in a production workflow today.

items.title: Microdrama Producers Voice Cautious Optimism on the Sector Despite AI Worries
items.excerpt: Producers of premium mobile microdramas discussed how vertical storytelling craft is evolving and where generative AI fits, at the Access Canada Summit.

items.title: ‘About a Hero,’ AI-Generated Docu-Mystery Featuring Synthetic Werner Herzog, Debuts Trailer
items.excerpt: Piotr Winiewicz's film is co-authored by an AI trained on Werner Herzog's body of work with his permission; the model will join Q&As alongside the director when the film screens.

items.title: What I Learned Watching Six Hours of Gen-AI Short Films for the Reply AI Film Festival
items.excerpt: IndieWire's Brian Welk served on the jury of the Venice-based Reply AI Film Festival and reports on what six hours of generative shorts reveal about the craft ceiling of the form.

items.title: Werner Herzog on David Lynch, AI, and Why His Unhinged New Film ‘Bucking Fastard’ Skipped Cannes for Venice
items.excerpt: Herzog talks directing actors, David Lynch and his complicated position on AI — the same year an AI trained on his films co-directs a documentary about him.

items.title: After Effects AI Assistant enters public beta
items.excerpt: Adobe's After Effects AI Assistant is now in open public beta: it reads an entire project to reorganize files, write expressions and repair broken animation rigs, demoed live at IBC2026.

items.title: Blackmagic keeps AI on assistant duty in DaVinci Resolve, for now
items.excerpt: Blackmagic explains why Resolve 21.1's AI handles editorial chores like auto highlight reels but deliberately stops short of generating synthetic audio or frames — a stated line between assistance and authorship.

items.title: Adobe sees AI as a workflow assistant, not a creative director
items.excerpt: In an IBC interview, Adobe's video team frames Premiere Pro's new AI features — generation, sound effects, audio cleanup — as solutions to concrete production problems rather than replacements for editorial judgment.

items.title: Blender 5.3 Is Getting Native 3D Gaussian Splat Support
items.excerpt: Blender 5.3 will import and render 3D Gaussian Splats from PLY and SPZ files natively across all render engines, removing the add-on dependency for neural-capture plates in film and previs work.

items.title: AOTO Brings Creators and Technology Together at CITS 2026, Celebrating the Best in Virtual Production
items.excerpt: AOTO's CITS 2026 summit in Beijing ran under the theme 'AI + XR Reshaping Content Creation' and handed out the first Golden Screen Awards for virtual production work.

items.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
items.excerpt: AMI Labs, World Labs and peers have raised huge sums on world models — the tech underpinning generative sets and scene generation — yet stay quiet about what they are actually shipping, even to their data suppliers.

items.title: Master Realistic AI Casting
items.excerpt: Runway walks through building believable, consistent characters for generative shots — an AI 'casting' workflow aimed at filmmakers who need the same face to hold across a sequence.

items.title: New Course: AI for Micro-Dramas
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge announces a course on producing vertical micro-dramas with AI tooling, one of the fastest-growing formats pulling generative video into episodic production.
